'''Version 1.9.17''' was an update for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod, released on February 7th 2024.  It was 24.89 MB.

====<u>General</u>====
*Added new sound effects for the [[Evolution Phases]]
*Added more subtitles**
*[[Lures|Lure Blocks]] will now spawn particles or a thunder if used together
====<u>Mobs</u>====
*Tweaked [[Scent System|Scent]] spawning [[Primitive Tozoon|worms]] logic
*Changed [[Adapted Summoner ]]Spawning biomass sound effect
*Added small step sound effect to walking heads, [[Gnat|Gnats]], [[Rupter|Rupters]], [[Mangler|Manglers]]
*Added new sound effect for [[Primitive Yelloweye|Yellow Eye]] shooting
*Added/tweaked new Growl/Hurt/Death sound effect for the following mobs: 
**[[Primitive Vermin]], Walking heads, [[Host]] when underground, [[Herd]] when underground, [[Light Carrier]], [[Heavy Carrier]], [[Flying Carrier]], [[Monarch]], [[Adapted Bolster]], [[Marauder]]
